declared.question: which DF Hessian classes (d2eri3 through (ff|i), d2metric through (i|i)) the low-stack gate must cover, and whether the low-stack form keeps every class within #606's ~14 KB of stack and the 300 s compile budget
declared.rule: per class, over every arch with rows: a class's UNROLLED form is admissible when its stack is at most STACK_BUDGET_B = 14,000 B and its compile finishes within COMPILE_BUDGET_S = 300 s; one not compiled on an arch (above the first L level with an inadmissible class there) is inadmissible. Per target the gate is an L floor, LOWSTACK_MIN_L = the smallest L with an inadmissible class: every class below it must be admissible (so it stays unrolled), every class at or above it is gated. Every low-stack unit must compile within COMPILE_BUDGET_S on every arch with rows; its frame is RECORDED, not gated: the d2 forms read the bra's per-axis E two indices up, 9.5 KB of tables alone at (ff|.) before R, U and the operated factors, so #606's 14 KB is not a bound this form can meet at f, and an exploratory compile before this rule (d2eri3_336, 24,544 B on sm_86) said so
declared.expected: the unrolled d2 forms hold 28 operator triples' densities (d2eri3) and read the tower two up, so both floors sit at or below the d1 ones (geri3 5, gmetric 10); the low-stack d2eri3 frames are R (n_t(L + 2)), U, the bra tables two indices up and six operated factors per axis, ~20-25 KB at (ff|.) with spill; the low-stack d2metric ones under 14 KB
